zh.title: Tesla Adds a Chinese Large Model to Its China Cars for the First Time
zh.summary: The company has begun rolling out ByteDance’s Doubao model inside its China vehicle software, a rare departure from its preference for in-house systems. The move addresses cabin experience and local requirements while core driving technology remains under Tesla’s own control.
